name: Ashibetsu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ashibetsu city emblem in white: an outlined five-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ashibetsu, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 July 1948.

features.role: Ashibetsu city emblem — an outlined five-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character
